object.attr: derived: an agent writes review records that must stay checkable, and a short hash can become ambiguous as a repository grows; the reasoning of MELLON-VER-SRS-87. The field name `hash` is the review's recommendation and still open (review Q32).
object.description: When the MCP server commits for a `commit_message`, the MCP server should return the commit's full hash in `commit` as `hash`.
